status.owner: Jio Platforms Limited (majority owned subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited)
status.scope_reason: The company designs and manufactures survey-grade mapping drones (like the A200-XT) and provides end-to-end GIS drone surveying services and cloud-based photogrammetry software.
status.evidence: Asteria Aerospace offers the A200-XT mapping drone and its SkyDeck platform for cloud photogrammetry and drone mapping workflows according to its website.

claims.claim: The company reports offering the A200-XT, a DGCA type-certified small-class multi-purpose drone for mapping, surveying, and inspection applications featuring swappable payload options and calibrated sensors.

The company reports offering the AT-15, an indigenous long-range fixed-wing VTOL platform built with carbon fiber composite structures that features an integrated EO-IR payload and is managed via the Asteria Mission Control software.
claims.note: managed via the Asteria Mission Control software

claims.claim: The company reports that its cloud-based SaaS platform, SkyDeck, provides end-to-end data processing workflows utilizing 2D and 3D photogrammetry techniques to transform raw aerial imagery into orthomosaics, digital terrain models, realistic textured meshes, and detailed point clouds.

The company reports that SkyDeck integrates automated processing tools for geospatial and volumetric analytics, including volume calculations, surface measurements, elevation profiles, and compatibility with a specialized QGIS plugin.
claims.note: automated processing tools for geospatial and volumetric analytics, including volume calculations, surface measurements, elevation profiles

claims.claim: The company reports that its integrated high-resolution cameras can achieve a ground sampling distance (GSD) of <3 cm/pixel from a flight altitude of 120 meters.

The company reports that its AT-15 hybrid fixed-wing VTOL drone delivers a flight endurance of up to 120 minutes with a maximum take-off weight of 8 kg and is equipped with a blended-wing aerodynamic design supporting quick-connect swappable payloads.

The company reports that its DGCA type-certified A410-XT multirotor platform delivers a flight time of 60 minutes with its maximum payload, featuring quick-connect swappable payloads that can be configured in under 30 seconds.

Asteria Aerospace Limited was ranked the lowest bidder (L1) at ₹11.03 crore for a Survey of India contract to procure professional survey-grade UAVs/drones for large-scale mapping across the country under the SVAMITVA Scheme.

According to Registrar of Companies (RoC) filings for FY25, Asteria Aerospace Limited's revenue from services (primarily aerial mapping and agricultural analytics) was ₹47 lakh, declining from ₹5.32 crore recorded in FY24.
The company's overall operational revenue for FY25 grew 90% year-on-year to ₹78.7 crore, up from ₹41.6 crore in FY24, with product sales remaining the primary driver at ₹75.5 crore. ·Startup.Pedia +1

The company reports having mapped more than 5,000 villages under the Indian government's SVAMITVA scheme, monitored over 30,000 kilometers of oil and gas pipelines, and deployed over 750 drones across various defense and enterprise applications.

The company maintains its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Bengaluru, India, operates with a workforce of approximately 250 individuals including over 50 trained drone pilots, and states that it has sales and support offices nationwide.
claims.note: Workforce of approximately 250 individuals, including over 50 trained drone pilots, and sales and support offices nationwide
claims.source: Asteria Aerospace Official Site & Industry Profiles

claims.claim: The company announced a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Drone Destination Limited to expand global unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sales and services, collaborating on utilizing Drone Destination's fleet and pilots alongside Asteria Aerospace's SkyDeck cloud platform for international data processing, analytics, and visualization across mapping-relevant sectors like oil and gas, telecommunications, agriculture, and mining.
claims.source: Times of India & Drone Destination Press Release (February 2025)

claims.claim: The company reports an installed base of over 750 drones deployed across various domains, including defense, homeland security, GIS, oil and gas, agriculture, construction, and mining.
The company reports that its deployed systems have mapped more than 5,000 villages under the government's SVAMITVA geographic information system (GIS) mapping program.

status.main_product: Geospatial data solutions, including drone, terrestrial handheld, and UAV LiDAR surveying and mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone and UAV surveying, mapping, and terrestrial LiDAR scanning services under its own name.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs records listed on ZaubaCorp, TerraOrbit Mapping Private Limited is an active company incorporated in December 2024 with its registered office in Telangana, India.

claims.claim: The company reports integrating airborne LiDAR, UAV photogrammetry, and ground-penetrating radar (GPR) into an integrated geospatial platform to simultaneously capture three-dimensional spatial data for complex infrastructure projects.
claims.note: integrated geospatial platform simultaneously capturing airborne LiDAR, UAV photogrammetry, and ground-penetrating radar data for complex infrastructure projects

claims.claim: The company reports offering photogrammetry services including aerial triangulation, point cloud and 3D model/mesh generation, and digital elevation products (DEM/DTM/DSM), alongside LiDAR processing, validation, analytics, and feature extraction.

The company reports its capabilities include capturing data accurate up to 2 cm to ensure precision for geospatial projects, along with utilizing advanced data processing from airborne digital sensors.
claims.note: capturing data accurate up to 2 cm and utilizing advanced data processing from airborne digital sensors

claims.claim: The company reports delivering millimeter-level precision from the field for high-accuracy 3D laser scanning deployed for tunnel infrastructure, including structural deformation analysis and complete 3D profiling.

The company reports that its integrated geospatial platform combines airborne LiDAR, UAV photogrammetry, and ground-penetrating radar (GPR) to capture all three dimensions simultaneously for complex environments like airports.
claims.note: integrated platform combining airborne LiDAR, UAV photogrammetry, and ground-penetrating radar simultaneously for airport environments

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reported plans in December 2025 to establish an in-house application development team and launch a new web application as part of R&D initiatives to drive innovation.
claims.note: plans in December 2025 to establish an in-house application development team and launch a new web application
claims.source: Company profiles and social media updates

claims.claim: The company reported mapping over 900 km of roads and over 100 sq km of area across various industries during its first year, delivering LiDAR and topographical surveys for sectors including roads, railways, metro projects, canals, F4 racetracks, and mining.
claims.note: mapping over 900 km of roads and over 100 sq km of area across various industries during its first year, delivering LiDAR and topographical surveys for sectors including roads, railways, metro projects, canals, F4 racetracks, and mining
